title: Screening for frequent hospitalization risk among community-dwelling older adult between 2016 and 2023: machine learning-driven item selection, scoring system development, and prospective validation
summary: In 1,611 community-service clients, DeepBoost selected 17 items and achieved AUC 0.90 across operational definitions. A prospective cohort of 329 older adults recruited from a different district during the COVID-19 period validated the score with AUC 0.82 for identifying two or more hospitalizations over two years. The study documents prospective validation in a different district and later time period (329 adults; 13.1% reported at least two hospitalizations over two years). This is a specific clinical retrospective outcome with prospective score validation; no causal treatment effect is claimed.
ai_technology: DeepBoost selects a 17-item short form from comprehensive geriatric assessment items and derives a risk score for frequent hospitalization among community-dwelling older adults.
